name: QTI - Quantum Telecommunications Italy
description: QTI is an Italian start-up that engineers, develops, and produces reconfigurable quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. A spin-off of the Italian National Institute of Optics (CNR-INO), the company serves private companies, government agencies, and research institutions with quantum-secured communication solutions.
